fm_transmitter, vendored unmodified.

  Upstream   https://github.com/markondej/fm_transmitter
  Commit     322500ed9cbe6252a640e566a68596215b9a3ba5  (2026-06-12, "Fixed integer ranges, issue #209"), version 0.9.7
  Copied     the eight files below, byte for byte. Nothing else from the repository (no sample .wav, no README).
  Licence    BSD 3-clause. See NOTICE. Marcin Kondej wrote it; mailbox.c/h are Broadcom's.

Why it is here: the head unit's FM helper builds it ON the Pi it will run on (deploy/setup-fm.sh), from exactly this source, with no
download. setup-fm.sh checks these checksums before it compiles; if one differs it stops. To update, copy the new upstream files, read
the diff, replace the commit and the sums below, and re-run the helper's tests.

It only runs on Raspberry Pi boards up to the Pi 4 (BCM2835/2836/2837/2711). The Pi 5 is NOT supported by upstream and the helper
refuses to start it there.
